items.name: Stevenage Newcomers Saturday 2024
items.information:
This competition is targeted a first-time competitors and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Medals will be awarded to the fastest newcomers.

**PLEASE NOTE**: This is a Series Competition with Stevenage Newcomers Sunday 2024. You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StevenageNewcomersSat2024#36086-series-competition) tab.

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

[![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions in the Midwest.
